title: Discharge time and subsequent quench transfer for small sheet-metal parts in a solution-treatment furnace
summary: Delivering a tray outside the furnace does not mean the workpiece has reached the next cooling station. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s small quenching-furnace proposal dated 24 July 2023 concerns solution heating of opening-frame blanks and small sheet-metal parts. It specifies “no more than 5–7 seconds” from door opening to the tray reaching its discharged position. Define that position before planning unloading and onward transfer; this interval is not complete immersion time.
